description: NIST's CTC-01 whole: edge #1864, the exporter's cubic B-spline for the meeting of the cylinders #127 (r 25) and #155 (r 10) and within 0.0065 of both by Open CASCADE's reading, was refused as a gap of 0.02 past the cap of 0.01, a number that was no distance but the fit tolerance one growth past the cap. The fit holds its image to a fraction of the tolerance it is asked for, and the curve lies 0.0065 off the surface, so no fit at the cap could pass: the reader now lets the fit's search run one growth past the cap, and the cap judges the gap the pcurve leaves, measured. Not shrunk below the part, whose own two cylinder faces a closed solid round that edge would have to rebuild; FTC-07's edge #1963 is the same fault (ADR-0026 §4)
